stages.title: STATE CAPACITY AS AN INTEGRATED ARCHITECTURE

pills.text: STATE CAPACITY AS AN INTEGRATED ARCHITECTURE
DIFFERENTIATED FINANCE, MILITARY, HOUSEHOLD AND GRANT FUNCTIONS
RANKS ELITE STATUS, REMUNERATION AND SERVICE OBLIGATION
MEASUREMENT, AVERAGES, RECORDS AND LOCAL MEDIATION FUND THE STATE
DAGH, CHEHRA, ACCOUNTS AND NEWS TEST PAPER CLAIMS
SUBSTANTIAL CAPACITY REMAINED PERSONAL, HIERARCHICAL AND UNEVEN.

MANSABDARI → ranks elite status, remuneration and service obligation

VERIFICATION → dagh, chehra, accounts and news test paper claims
